evidence_summary: Replay shows POST /collections/create with vectorFieldType="InvalidVectorType" returning HTTP 200 code=0, and describe confirming the collection exists with vector field silently created as FloatVector instead of the expected 400 invalid-parameter rejection.
rationale: Semantic match to Type1 illegal-success: one clean reproduction where an invalid enum parameter was accepted and silently coerced to a default, violating the behavioral contract 'Returns 400 on invalid parameters' (milvus_behavioral_collections_create_001), corroborated by follow-up describe; the payload's quick-create style and developer_cognition issue 50351/50319 by-design silent-ignore stance may mitigate novelty but not the reproduced contract divergence.
